name: send_message
description: Write to correspondents by ID. A reference means the sending service accepted your message for delivery.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can run host commands and report what it finds to the core.

name: send_focus_message
description: Share a thought or update with an existing focus. The message can wake a sleeping or interrupted recipient.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to later. Arranges an observation for the core that survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Create a subscription whose reports can wake this focus. Give the new subscription_id to a listener you set up separately. An activity can run "$IVENNA_REPORT" --help for reporting commands and examples.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it reports.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Close any focus's subscription to new reports. Reports already accepted still reach the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
